offering_description.value: Builds and maintains roads, highways and site infrastructure in the Southeastern US. It sells paving and heavy civil construction to public agencies and private developers, and supplies its own asphalt and aggregates from owned plants and quarries.

primary_products.value: hot-mix asphalt; crushed stone aggregates; liquid asphalt; ready-mix concrete

primary_services.value: road paving; highway and bridge construction; site grading and utilities; pavement maintenance

customer_segment.value: B2G: state and local departments of transportation, cities and counties; B2B: private developers, commercial site owners and contractors

end_markets.value: public infrastructure; commercial construction; residential development

revenue_model.value: project or contract: paving and construction contracts awarded by public agencies and developers; product sales: asphalt, aggregates and concrete sold to contractors and customers

value_chain_position.value: service provider: performs road and site construction work for public and private owners; OEM / manufacturer: produces asphalt and aggregates from its own plants, used in its own projects and sold to others; asset operator: owns and runs quarries, asphalt plants and paving equipment fleets
value_chain_position.category: service provider; OEM / manufacturer; asset operator

geography_served.value: US regional: Southeastern states including Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Louisiana, Mississippi, North Carolina, South Carolina and Tennessee

specialization.value: related lines: paving and heavy civil construction, asphalt and aggregates production, and site work

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: bids and contracts won directly from public agencies and private developers; own locations: owned asphalt plants and quarries that supply materials to its projects and customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: environmental permits for quarries and asphalt plants, plus state DOT specifications and safety rules
